title: Balanced regulation of UvsX activity and thermostability based on active learning.
authors: Li, Lingsong; Zhang, Lin; Li, Dongxiao; Zhang, Jiaxing; You, Shengping; Su, Rongxin; Qi, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文结合蛋白语言模型与能量筛选对RPA关键酶UvsX进行半理性工程改造，并通过分子动力学模拟解析突变机制，属于蛋白质结构相关计算建模在酶工程中的应用，方法有创新但对象为功能酶而非典型结构预测/设计问题。
abstract: Recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) enables isothermal nucleic acid detection. However, the key enzyme UvsX of RPA exhibits suboptimal efficiency at low-temperature conditions and low template concentration. Here, we employed a directed engineering strategy combining energy-based screening and protein language models (PLMs). Through semi rational design and iterative optimization with EVOLVEpro, we obtained a triple mutant, TIG (S233T/A311I/A341G), which achieved 1.89-fold RPA relative activity of the wild-type (WT) at a template concentration of 1 x 10(5) copies reaction(-1), and showed higher amplification activity to WT across 37.5-44.3  degrees C at a template concentration of 1 x 10(4) copies reaction(-1). Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that TIG enhances residue flexibility and remodels the ATP-binding pocket, thereby improving DNA-binding pathway connectivity and strengthening the coupling between ATP hydrolysis and DNA strand exchange. Per-residue energy decomposition and protein structure network analyses further elucidate how key mutations modulate DNA-binding pathways. Finally, under optimized expression conditions (20  degrees C, 12 h, 0.1 mM IPTG), the yield reached 206.87 +/- 3.56 mg L(-1) of TIG. Collectively, this study provides a strategy for UvsX engineering and establishes a foundation for the development of more robust RPA assays.
abstract_zh: 重组酶聚合酶扩增（recombinase polymerase amplification, RPA）可实现等温核酸检测。然而，RPA的关键酶UvsX在低温条件和低模板浓度下表现出次优效率。在此，我们采用了一种结合基于能量的筛选和蛋白质语言模型（protein language models, PLMs）的定向工程策略。通过半理性设计和EVOLVEpro迭代优化，我们获得了一个三重突变体TIG（S233T/A311I/A341G），其在模板浓度为1 x 10(5)拷贝反应(-1)时，RPA相对活性达到野生型（WT）的1.89倍，并且在模板浓度为1 x 10(4)拷贝反应(-1)时，在37.5-44.3摄氏度范围内表现出高于WT的扩增活性。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟揭示，TIG增强了残基灵活性并重塑了ATP结合口袋，从而改善了DNA结合路径的连通性，并加强了ATP水解与DNA链交换之间的耦合。逐残基能量分解和蛋白质结构网络分析进一步阐明了关键突变如何调节DNA结合路径。最后，在优化表达条件下（20摄氏度，12小时，0.1 mM IPTG），TIG的产量达到206.87 +/- 3.56 mg L(-1)。总体而言，本研究为UvsX工程化提供了一种策略，并为开发更稳健的RPA检测方法奠定了基础。
